activeConversationId.description: The id of the active conversation. Use with onActiveConversationChange to control it.

adapter.description: The adapter that connects the chat to your backend.

composerValue.description: The value of the composer. Use with onComposerValueChange to control it.

conversations.description: The conversations. Use with onConversationsChange to control them.

currentUser.description: The local user sending messages. If omitted, derived from members by finding the entry with role === 'user'. Also used to enrich message authors when a rendered message resolves to currentUser.id.

features.description: Runtime feature flags for the chat controller (e.g. outbound typing signals).

getMessageAuthorAvatarUrl.description: Used to determine the avatar URL for a given message author. Falls back to message.author?.avatarUrl, then to the matched member's avatarUrl.

getMessageAuthorDisplayName.description: Used to determine the display name for a given message author. Falls back to message.author?.displayName, then to the matched member's displayName.

getMessageAuthorId.description: Used to determine the author id for a given message. The resolved id is used to match message authors against currentUser, members, and active conversation participants.

initialActiveConversationId.description: The initial active conversation ID when uncontrolled. Ignored after initialization and when activeConversationId is provided.

initialComposerValue.description: The initial composer value when uncontrolled. Ignored after initialization and when composerValue is provided.

initialConversations.description: The initial conversations when uncontrolled. Ignored after initialization and when conversations is provided.

initialMessages.description: The initial messages when uncontrolled. Ignored after initialization and when messages is provided.

members.description: Known chat participants. Used to derive the local user / assistant user when explicit props are omitted, and to enrich message authors by resolved author id at render time.

messages.description: The messages of the active conversation. Use with onMessagesChange to control them.

onActiveConversationChange.description: Callback fired when the active conversation changes.

conversationId.name: conversationId
conversationId.description: The id of the new active conversation.

onComposerValueChange.description: Callback fired when the composer value changes.

onConversationsChange.description: Callback fired when the conversations change.

onData.description: Callback fired when a data part is received.

onError.description: Callback fired when an error occurs.

onFinish.description: Callback fired when the assistant finishes a response, including when it is aborted, disconnected, or fails.

payload.name: payload
payload.description: The final message and how the response ended.

onMessagesChange.description: Callback fired when the messages change.

onToolCall.description: Callback fired when the assistant calls a tool.

partRenderers.description: Custom renderers for message parts, by part type.

roleDisplayNames.description: Locale-driven fallback labels for messages without explicit author information.

storeClass.description: The store class to use for this provider.

streamFlushInterval.description: Flush interval in milliseconds for batching rapid streaming deltas before applying them to the store.
